description: Analyze the 9 failed build modules: build_start_all_sh, build_graphql_schema, build_email_guid_auth, build_mcp_detail_view_ui, build_advanced_filter_api, build_forensic_detail_api, build_manual_override_api, build_compliance_export_service, build_supervisor_auto_updater.
